summary: Frontend-only validation of Shipments dashboard UI refactor (iter-31). All 8 acceptance criteria from the review request pass. Seeded one active shipment (#2, send_stones_to_lab, FedEx, TEST-ITER31, 2 jobs / 8 stones / 4 certificates / 20.00 ct / $46,000) and exercised detail modal, edit mode, cancel double-confirm, sticky footer scroll, Create Shipment dialog picker, Add Jobs dialog picker, and job-detail regression.

test_results.compact_header_meta_strip: PASS — single-line strip with type icon + 'Send Stones to Lab' + pending badge + Courier: FedEx + Tracking: TEST-ITER31 + From: HK Office → To: GRS HK Lab + Sent date. No 2x3 grid in body.
test_results.no_top_cancel_button: PASS — cancel-shipment-button not present in non-edit mode; top-right has Print PDF / Edit / Add Jobs only.
test_results.sticky_totals_footer: PASS — shipment-totals-footer present; totals-jobs=2, totals-stones=8, totals-certificates=4, totals-weight='20.00 ct' (ct suffix ✓), totals-fees='$0' ($ format ✓), totals-value='$46,000' ($ format ✓). Footer remained visible after scrolling body to bottom.
test_results.edit_mode_cancel_save: PASS — clicking edit-shipment-button reveals red cancel-shipment-button (text='Cancel Shipment', full text) next to save-shipment-edit-button at bottom of form.
test_results.cancel_double_confirm: PASS — clicking cancel-shipment-button opens ConfirmDialog titled 'Cancel shipment TEST-ITER31?' with Keep / Cancel Shipment buttons (verified in screenshot 04).
test_results.hidden_for_terminal_states: PASS (code review) — JSX guards `selectedShipment.status !== 'cancelled' && selectedShipment.status !== 'completed'` in page.tsx ~L1285; could not be exercised live because no cancelled/completed shipment was seeded, but conditional is correct.
test_results.create_dialog_picker_rows: PASS — 78 select-job-{n} rows rendered. Sample row select-job-586: 'Job #586 EXPRESS ofir11 Ruby 1 stones · 1 cert 1.00 ct Fee $450 Value $1,000'. All required fields present (service chip, client, stone-types, stones+cert count, ct weight, $ fee, $ value). Click toggles selection (bg-navy-100 class applied).
test_results.add_jobs_picker_rows: PASS — 76 add-job-{n} rows rendered with identical expanded layout. Sample add-job-586 matched Create dialog formatting.
test_results.regression_job_detail: PASS — clicking shipment-job-row-584 opens Job #584 detail dialog showing Service Type / Status / Total Stones / Value / Fee / Signed Memo / Stones table.

critical_code_review_comments: page.tsx is now ~2318 lines — exceeds the >700-line guideline. Recommend extracting (a) the detail modal, (b) Create Shipment dialog, (c) Add Jobs dialog into separate components under shipments/_components/ to improve maintainability. JobPickerRow extraction was a good start.

Terminal-state guard for the in-edit Cancel button (cancelled/completed) is correct in code but is not covered by an automated test because no cancelled/completed shipment exists in seed data. Consider seeding one of each for regression coverage.
